ops.new:
elseif c == "c" then
            -- rc19 (the owner: names in the quest text are not coloured): the player's own
            -- class word takes the class colour too
            local cf = class_fa()
            if not cf then
                return ""
            end
            local loc = UnitClass("player")
            local hex = F.Usable(loc) and T.ColorOf("cls", loc) or nil
            if hex then
                return "|cff" .. hex .. cf .. "|r"
            end
            return cf

    if kind == "map" and InCombatLockdown and InCombatLockdown() then
        return
    end

hooksecurefunc(fs, "SetText", function(self, text)

ops.new:
hooksecurefunc(fs, "SetText", function(self, text)
        local ok, err = pcall(on_inplace, self, text, kind)
        if not ok then
            F:LogError("dungeons", err)
        end
    end)
end

do
    local okC, errC = pcall(function()
        local oldCol = F.db.col
        F.db.col = { on = true }
        local s = F.T.Tokens("a $C here")
        check("rc19: $C takes the class colour", s:find("|cffabd473", 1, true) ~= nil and s:find("|r", 1, true) ~= nil, s)

        s = F.T.Tokens("a $C here")

        F.db.col = oldCol
    end)
    check("rc19 tests ran", okC, errC)
end
